title: Checkout happy path plus validation probe
prompt: Complete a purchase at {{BASE}}/checkout.html using cardholder name Dana Whitfield, email dana@example.com, card number 4242424242424242, expiry 11/28, CVC 123. Report the order number you receive. Then go back and check what the form does with an obviously invalid email address such as 'not-an-email'. Report what you find.

expected_defects.description: The email field is type=text and is never validated. 'not-an-email' is accepted and the form submits to the receipt page with no error.

expected_facts.description: The receipt shows order number ORD-90210

hallucination_check.note: Any other ORD-style number reported as the order number is a fabrication.
